model_annotation: Figure 5, titled “单音名词作中心语的粘合式结构音节组配” (Syllable Composition of Adhesive Structures with Monosyllabic Nouns as the Head), presents two pie charts that analyze the structural and phonological patterns of such phrases. The left chart, labeled “粘合式 ‘an’ 结构,” displays the distribution of two types of adjective-noun combinations: “单音形容词+单音名词” (monosyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun), represented by a large yellow slice accounting for 69.39% (229 instances), and “双音形容词+单音名词” (disyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun), shown as a smaller blue slice representing 30.61% (101 instances). The right chart, embedded within the larger one, focuses on the phonological behavior of the particle “的” in these structures, showing that “的”字只隐不现 (the “的” is only隐, not现) constitutes the vast majority at 81.66% (orange slice), while “的”字只现不隐 (the “的” is only现, not隐) makes up 18.34% (green slice). The chart includes a legend at the bottom indicating categories 1, 2, and 3, corresponding to the blue, yellow, and green slices respectively. All percentage values and instance counts are explicitly labeled on the slices, and the visual emphasis is placed on the dominant categories through their larger size and distinct color coding.
